title: Restriction coherence and replacement independence for localized Kan-diagram evaluation
statement:
Use simplicial sets and coherent functor quasicategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the coherent realization adjunction of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and infinity localization of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization]. Fix a universe $\mathcal V$, and let all indexing simplicial sets and values be $\mathcal V$-small; form the diagram categories and their localizations in a containing universe. Write $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\operatorname{Kan}_{\mathcal V})$. For each simplicial set $K$, not necessarily a quasicategory, let $\mathsf D_K^f$ be the ordinary category of enriched functors $\mathfrak C[K]\to\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal V}$ with Kan values and enriched natural maps, and let $W_K$ be its objectwise weak homotopy equivalences. Put $\mathcal L_K=N(\mathsf D_K^f)[W_K^{-1}]_\infty$ with localization map $q_K$. Let $e_K:N(\mathsf D_K^f)\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$ be enriched evaluation $e_K(P)=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(P)\eta_K$, and let $E_K:\mathcal L_K\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$ be its localized comparison, with $E_Kq_K\simeq e_K$, as specified in [lem-coef-kan-diagram-localized-evaluation].

For every simplicial map $v:K'\to K$, ordinary restriction $v^*P=P\mathfrak C[v]$ preserves $W_K$ and objectwise Kan diagrams, and induces $\overline{v^*}:\mathcal L_K\to\mathcal L_{K'}$. The exact evaluation identity $e_{K'}(v^*P)=e_K(P)v$ induces a coherent natural equivalence $E_{K'}\overline{v^*}\simeq v^*E_K$. These comparisons are jointly coherent for identity maps, composites of indexing maps, ordinary diagram transformations and all higher simplices of their infinity localizations.

For every ordinary functorial projective cofibrant replacement $Q_K$ on $\mathsf D_K^f$ with its natural trivial fibration $a_K:Q_K\to1$, the maps $e_K(a_K)$ are natural equivalences, and their induced comparisons through $E_Kq_K\simeq e_K$ are coherently compatible with restriction and independent of the replacement. In particular, comparison after restriction uses $Q_{K'}(v^*P)\to v^*P$, without requiring $v^*(Q_KP)$ to be projectively cofibrant. No simplicial enrichment of $Q_K$ is assumed.
